profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a non-profit government research laboratory founded in 2020, described on its site as a global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its site presents the Falcon family of generative large language models, which it describes as open-source, multilingual, and multimodal. Named models include Falcon 180B, a 180 billion parameter model trained on 3.5 trillion tokens; Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens; Falcon 2 11B; Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open source released State Space Language Model; Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E; Falcon H1R 7B, a 7B reasoning model; Falcon Arabic, built for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects; and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model that reads and understands images from natural language prompts. The site states that Falcon-H1 uses a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B, as verified on the Hugging Face Leaderboard. It also states that Falcon 180B sits at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained Open Large Language Models.

The site describes the launch of the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models, and mentions AI71, an AI company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, which issued a global Call for Proposals for developers to build use cases with Falcon 10B. It also describes a Falcon LLM Hackfest called the Wings of Innovation Challenge and an initiative to convene university researchers and AI practitioners around the Falcon LLM series.

The available record lists one tracked product, Falcon (TII), categorized under Chat and General LLMs, with notes describing it as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM under Apache 2.0 with Middle East data residency. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent facts are present in the material.
